name: gta-free-stem-opportunities
description: Open-source free STEM opportunity finder for GTA families, students, educators, and community hosts.

scripts.build: tsx scripts/export-public-opportunities.ts && next build && cp hosting/static-vercel.json out/vercel.json && tsx scripts/prepare-startup-html.ts
scripts.engine:refresh: npm run generate:library && npm run prepare:library && npm run discover:write && npm run export:public-feed && npm run youth:refresh && npm run qa
scripts.qa: tsx scripts/qa-check.ts && npm run qa:search && npm run qa:catalog && npm run verify:native-export && npm run qa:filters && npm run qa:motion && npm run qa:high-school && npm run qa:youth-hunter && npm run verify:youth-feed && npm run qa:accessibility-support
scripts.build:app-release: npm run build && npm run verify:legal:release
scripts.deploy:pages: npm run build:github-pages && npx --yes wrangler@4.152.0 pages deploy out --project-name=gta-free-stem --branch=main
scripts.verify:native-export: tsx scripts/native-publication.test.ts && tsx scripts/native-content-rights.test.ts && tsx scripts/export-public-opportunities.ts --self-test
scripts.predev: npm run prepare:library && npm run prepare:map && npm run prepare:search
scripts.prebuild: npm run prepare:library && npm run prepare:map && npm run prepare:search
scripts.qa:catalog: tsx scripts/library-collector-regression.ts && tsx scripts/library-rss-cache-regression.ts && tsx scripts/library-catalog-regression.ts && tsx lib/search.community.test.ts && tsx lib/opportunitySearch.worker.test.ts && npm run verify:library-partition
scripts.build:github-pages: GTA_HOST_TARGET=github-pages npm run build && python3 scripts/prepare-github-pages.py && npm run verify:search-indexing && npm run verify:program-descriptions
scripts.qa:accessibility-support: tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 lib/accessibilitySupport.test.ts lib/accessibilitySelection.test.ts lib/accessibility/reviewedPolicies.test.ts lib/scopedPresets/criteria.test.ts lib/scopedPresets/repository.test.ts lib/scopedPresets/controlRendering.test.tsx lib/scopedPresets/localOnlyUrl.test.ts lib/highSchool/presetTransition.test.ts lib/highSchool/roleConsumer.test.tsx
